title: Public Alert No. 029/2025 – Notice to Recall Embacef 125 Powder For Oral Suspension

products.manufacturer: Laborate Pharmaceutical India, E-11 Industrial Area, Panipat 132103

summary: NAFDAC has ordered a recall of Embacef-125 Powder for Oral Suspension (cefuroxime axetil) after complaints that the reconstituted suspension caked within a day. Investigation confirmed poor quality; batch PEDSE001 and similar batches are being mopped up nationwide.
